input: Find theater, drama, musical theater, improv and film-making summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Asheville, NC (every part of the city: downtown, West, North, South and East Asheville). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville theater drama musical theatre summer camps 2026 kids
theater drama summer camps Black Mountain Swannanoa Weaverville 2026

candidates.name: Asheville Community Theatre
candidates.note: Tanglewood camps for ages 4–18 include acting, musical theater, film and design; 2026 sessions included full- and half-day options.

candidates.name: Asheville Performing Arts Academy
candidates.note: Weeklong musical-theater workshops for grades 1–9 include performance, sets, props and costumes.

candidates.name: The Performing Arts Company of Asheville (formerly Asheville Junior Theater)
candidates.note: Summer camps for ages 4–16 include musical theater and improv/sketch comedy; formerly Asheville Junior Theater.

candidates.name: Playground Stage
candidates.note: 2026 musical-theater camps at Avery’s Creek Community Center included acting, singing, dancing, sets and costumes.

candidates.name: Forest Floor Wilderness Programs
candidates.note: 2026 Theater Camp used Haw Creek Commons in East Asheville, with afternoon pickup.

candidates.name: Asheville Dance Theater
candidates.note: Summer Wicked camp includes musical-theater dance, jazz and Oz-themed crafts.

candidates.name: University of North Carolina Asheville
candidates.note: June 2026 residential Film Scoring & Sound Design program for rising high-school sophomores–seniors; film-audio rather than film production.

candidates.name: Black Mountain Center for the Arts
candidates.note: 2026 camps include Broadway Beats musical theater, performing-arts showcases and teen storytelling activities.

candidates.name: Flat Rock Playhouse
candidates.note: Playhouse Jr. offered 2026 acting and musical-theater summer camps for rising K–12 students.

candidates.name: Parkway Playhouse
candidates.note: 2026 summer-camp listing identifies Parkway Playhouse Junior theater programming for ages 4–10.

candidates.name: Tryon Fine Arts Center
candidates.note: 2026 weeklong theater-production camp, jointly presented with Tryon Little Theater, ends in a fully staged public show.

candidates.name: Tryon Little Theater
candidates.note: Co-runs summer theater camp with Tryon Fine Arts Center; rehearsals and set/costume work begin at Sunnydale.

candidates.name: Calliope Stage
candidates.note: Three 2026 youth summer-camp offerings plus an evening Teen Playwriting Intensive for ages 12–18.

candidates.name: Jonesborough Repertory Theatre
candidates.note: Summer 2026 youth musical-theater classes include K–5 groups meeting in the late afternoon and evening.

candidates.name: Niswonger Performing Arts Center
candidates.note: Camp NPAC Kids ran in June 2025 for K–12 students, covering songs, dances, lines and a full stage production.

candidates.name: Tusculum University
candidates.note: Children’s summer Theatre Camp ran in 2025 and 2026, with age-group sessions and hands-on theater instruction.
